summary:
Research handoff recording the first confirmed violation and narrowing the now-answered unknown; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Confirmed result: direct check d37a13c51a594f278bc23ed2af078007 (plan unchanged from version 1) executed fresh as a898e05630e6440d97b856d7527274bd and the assessment now reports confirmed=true, outcome=violated, comparison_observed=true, bounded_complete=true, correspondence=no_issue_found and no blockers. Observed: a FSM implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore never has ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration invoked for a committed LogConfiguration entry (store_configuration_calls 0) while that entry is delivered through ApplyBatch (applybatch_config_indices [1,4]) with the admitted entry committed at index 4. The one earlier blocker was a harness observation-encoding defect (the scenario declaration lacked the op_id identity field) and was fixed by an F4 revision that changed only the harness source.

Product contents: an updated draft map (base version 2, will become version 3) with map_changes for exactly two objects — b-fsm-apply-committed, whose batching branch now carries the observed conditional relationship and whose unknown narrows to whether the interface combination is supported, and f-fsm-configuration-state, whose unknown narrows to the same contract question — plus feedback with the answered proposition, the remaining discriminators and the reference set (execution a898e056, artifact d37a13c5, the affected behavior/fact and the source materials). Impact is clarification only: no meaning, identity, edge, requirement or observation scope changed, so existing obligations and results keep their original basis.

Explicitly retained as unresolved: whether ConfigurationStore is meant to cover batching FSMs or whether implementing both interfaces is unsupported (under that reading the disposition would be a contract/documentation clarification, not a delivery defect), and the fact that the observation covers a single committed configuration entry on a single-voter carrier. No core A1/A2 discriminator has been selected yet; the accepted overview and remaining unread surfaces (net/tcp transport framing and its heartbeat fast path, observer plumbing, config reload) still hold unexplored candidates for the next question.
